title: Updating a padded word family
statement: Let $k,k'\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k\le k'$, let $i<k$, and let $u$ be a Boolean word. Extend the family of words indexed by $k$ that is empty at every index except $i$, where it equals $u$, to a family indexed by $k'$ by assigning the empty word at new indices. This extended family is empty at every index except the image of $i$ in the larger index set, where it equals $u$.
